objects.description: Instrumentation metrics for codecs (compression ratio, speeds, flags). Mainly for development and profiling; semantics of flags are not fully specified here.

objects.description: Function pointer type for supplying a custom multithreading backend used by Blosc to execute parallel jobs.

objects.description: I/O plugin callback type to open a stream/resource given a URL-like path and mode.

objects.description: I/O plugin callback type to close a previously opened stream.

objects.definition: typedef int64_t (*blosc2_size_cb)(void *stream);

objects.definition: typedef int64_t (*blosc2_write_cb)(const void *ptr, int64_t size, int64_t nitems, int64_t position, void *stream);
objects.description: I/O plugin callback type to write data into a stream at a position, size×nitems bytes.

objects.description: I/O plugin callback type to read data from a stream at a position; may allocate and set *ptr when is_allocation_necessary is false.

objects.description: I/O plugin callback type to resize/truncate the underlying resource to a given size.

I/O selection and parameters used when opening frames/schunks via user-defined backends.

objects.description: Opaque context type used for compression/decompression operations; created with create_cctx/dctx and freed with blosc2_free_ctx.
Pluggable tuning strategy for selecting block sizes and compression parameters and updating them based on timings.
Runtime parameters passed to user prefilter callbacks during compression.
Runtime parameters passed to user postfilter callbacks during decompression.

objects.definition: typedef int (*blosc2_prefilter_fn)(blosc2_prefilter_params* params);
objects.description: Function pointer type for user-defined prefilter applied before compression; returns 0 on success.

objects.definition: typedef int (*blosc2_postfilter_fn)(blosc2_postfilter_params* params);
objects.description: Function pointer type for user-defined postfilter applied after decompression; returns 0 on success.

Decompression context parameters (threads, optional owning schunk, postfilter and its parameters).

objects.definition: typedef struct blosc2_frame_s blosc2_frame;
objects.description: Opaque type representing a contiguous frame backing storage for a super-chunk; managed through schunk APIs.
Fixed-length metadata entry stored inside a super-chunk (name plus serialized content).
Storage configuration for creating/opening super-chunks (layout, path, default c/d params, and I/O backend).
Primary container holding a collection of (potentially large) Blosc-compressed chunks, optional frame backing, contexts, and metadata layers.
Platform-dependent timestamp type used by Blosc timing utilities (LARGE_INTEGER on Windows, struct timespec elsewhere).

typedef int (* blosc2_filter_backward_cb) (const uint8_t *, uint8_t *, int32_t, uint8_t, blosc2_dparams *,

Descriptor for a user-defined filter plugin (id, name, version and forward/backward callbacks).

Cache container for a single decompressed chunk’s data and its chunk index. If nchunk is -1 the cache is empty. Intended to avoid re-fetching the same chunk. The lifetime is managed by owners embedding this struct (e.g., inside b2nd_array_t).

objects.definition: typedef struct b2nd_context_s b2nd_context_t;   /* opaque type */

Concrete multidimensional array descriptor backed by a Blosc2 super-chunk. Stores shapes for data/chunks/blocks (and padded versions), precomputed strides, counts, dtype string and format, and an internal single-chunk cache. Use API functions to construct (uninit/empty/zeros/nans/full/from_*), serialize, slice, resize, and free with b2nd_free.
Opaque-ish wrapper struct holding a C stdio FILE* used by Blosc2 stdio-based I/O plugin. Holds the underlying file handle for stream operations.

Configuration and state for memory-mapped I/O backend used by Blosc2. Includes user-settable options (mode, initial mapping size, whether the struct should be freed by the destroy callback) and internal fields (mapped address, file path, sizes, flags, and platform-specific handle).

functions.name: blosc2_error_string
functions.signature: const char *blosc2_error_string(int error_code);
functions.description: Return a static, read-only string describing a Blosc2 error code. For unknown codes it returns "Unknown error". Useful for logging or mapping return codes to messages.
requirements: error_code may be any integer; unknown codes return a generic message
The returned pointer is to static storage; do not modify or free it

functions.name: blosc2_init
functions.signature: void blosc2_init(void);
functions.description: Initialize the Blosc library environment for global (non-context) API use.
requirements: Call before using other non-context Blosc APIs, unless exclusively using *_ctx APIs
Safe to call when starting to use the library in single-threaded style

functions.name: blosc2_destroy
functions.signature: void blosc2_destroy(void);
functions.description: Tear down the Blosc library environment created by blosc2_init.
requirements: Call after finishing all non-context Blosc operations, if blosc2_init was previously called

functions.name: blosc1_compress
functions.signature: int blosc1_compress(int clevel, int doshuffle, size_t typesize, size_t nbytes, const void* src, void* dest, size_t destsize);
functions.description: Compresses nbytes from src into dest using the Blosc 1.x-style API. Returns compressed size on success, 0 if destsize is insufficient, or negative on internal error.
requirements: src and dest must not overlap
0 <= clevel <= 9
doshuffle must be one of BLOSC_NOFILTER, BLOSC_SHUFFLE, BLOSC_BITSHUFFLE
For shuffle filters to be effective, 1 < typesize < 256; otherwise shuffle is disabled
dest must provide at least destsize bytes; to guarantee success set destsize >= nbytes + BLOSC2_MAX_OVERHEAD
nbytes is the number of bytes to read from src
Environment variables may override parameters as documented

functions.name: blosc1_decompress
functions.signature: int blosc1_decompress(const void* src, void* dest, size_t destsize);
functions.description: Decompress a Blosc-compressed buffer from src into dest using the Blosc 1.x-style API. Returns decompressed size on success or negative on error.
requirements: src and dest must not overlap
dest must have at least destsize bytes; decompressor never writes beyond destsize
To pre-validate and learn expected output size, optionally call blosc1_cbuffer_sizes first
Environment variables may influence threading as documented

functions.name: blosc1_getitem
functions.signature: int blosc1_getitem(const void* src, int start, int nitems, void* dest);
functions.description: Extract nitems items (of the original typesize) from a compressed buffer starting at logical item index start into dest. Legacy interface; see blosc2_getitem for a safer variant.
requirements: src must be a valid Blosc compressed buffer
start >= 0; nitems >= 0
dest must have enough space for nitems * typesize bytes
Behavior depends on the compressed buffer's typesize

functions.name: blosc2_getitem
functions.signature: int blosc2_getitem(const void* src, int32_t srcsize, int start, int nitems, void* dest, int32_t destsize);
functions.description: Safer getitem: Extract nitems items from a compressed buffer src of size srcsize starting at index start into dest (size destsize). Returns bytes copied or negative on error.
requirements: src must point to a compressed buffer of length srcsize
start >= 0; nitems >= 0
dest must have capacity destsize >= nitems * typesize
srcsize and destsize must be non-negative 32-bit lengths

functions.name: blosc2_set_threads_callback
functions.signature: void blosc2_set_threads_callback(blosc_threads_callback callback, void *callback_data);
functions.description: Set a custom threading backend callback for parallel work in compression/decompression. Passing NULL restores default Blosc-managed threads.
requirements: Not thread-safe; must be called before any other Blosc function
Affects all Blosc contexts globally
callback, if non-NULL, must implement the documented calling convention and not return until all jobs complete

functions.name: blosc2_get_nthreads
functions.signature: int16_t blosc2_get_nthreads(void);
functions.description: Return the current number of threads configured for compression/decompression.

functions.name: blosc2_set_nthreads
functions.signature: int16_t blosc2_set_nthreads(int16_t nthreads);
functions.description: Initialize or reconfigure the internal thread pool. If nthreads==1, selects serial mode and tears down any existing pool. Returns previous number of threads.
requirements: nthreads must be >= 1 (inferred from semantics of thread count)
Calling may create or destroy a thread pool

functions.name: blosc1_get_compressor
functions.signature: const char* blosc1_get_compressor(void);
functions.description: Get the name of the current default compressor.
requirements: Returns a pointer to an internal static string; do not modify or free

functions.name: blosc1_set_compressor
functions.signature: int blosc1_set_compressor(const char* compname);
functions.description: Set the default compressor by name (e.g., "blosclz", "lz4", "lz4hc", "zlib", "zstd"). Returns non-negative compcode on success, -1 on unknown/unsupported.
requirements: compname must be a supported compressor name in this build

functions.name: blosc2_set_delta
functions.signature: void blosc2_set_delta(int dodelta);
functions.description: Enable or disable the delta coding filter globally.
requirements: dodelta > 0 enables delta filter; dodelta == 0 disables it

functions.name: blosc2_compcode_to_compname
functions.signature: int blosc2_compcode_to_compname(int compcode, const char** compname);
functions.description: Map a compressor code to its name. On success returns code and sets *compname.
requirements: compname must be a valid pointer to receive the name
Unknown or unsupported compcode returns -1

functions.name: blosc2_compname_to_compcode
functions.signature: int blosc2_compname_to_compcode(const char* compname);
functions.description: Map a compressor name to its code. Returns code on success or -1 on unrecognized/unsupported name.
requirements: compname must be a non-NULL, null-terminated string naming a compressor

functions.name: blosc2_list_compressors
functions.signature: const char* blosc2_list_compressors(void);
functions.description: Return a comma-separated list of compressor names supported in the current build.
requirements: Returned string is managed by the library; do not free

functions.name: blosc2_get_version_string
functions.signature: const char* blosc2_get_version_string(void);
functions.description: Return the Blosc2 version string (e.g., "2.x.y").
requirements: Returned string is managed by the library; do not free

functions.name: blosc2_get_complib_info
functions.signature: int blosc2_get_complib_info(const char* compname, char** complib, char** version);
functions.description: Get compression library name and version for a given compressor name. Returns non-negative library code on success, -1 if not supported.
requirements: compname must name a compressor
On success, *complib and *version are allocated and must be freed by the caller
complib and version must be valid pointers to char*

functions.name: blosc2_free_resources
functions.signature: int blosc2_free_resources(void);
functions.description: Free temporary memory and thread resources when Blosc will be idle for a while.
requirements: Caller should not rely on cached temporaries after calling this function

functions.name: blosc1_cbuffer_sizes
functions.signature: void blosc1_cbuffer_sizes(const void* cbuffer, size_t* nbytes, size_t* cbytes, size_t* blocksize);
functions.description: Parse a compressed buffer header to obtain uncompressed size (nbytes), compressed size (cbytes), and blocksize.
requirements: cbuffer must point to at least BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH bytes of the compressed buffer
nbytes, cbytes, and blocksize must be valid pointers to receive values

functions.name: blosc2_cbuffer_sizes
functions.signature: int blosc2_cbuffer_sizes(const void* cbuffer, int32_t* nbytes, int32_t* cbytes, int32_t* blocksize);
functions.description: Same as blosc1_cbuffer_sizes but returns a status code and accepts NULL for any output pointer.
requirements: cbuffer must point to at least BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH bytes
Any of nbytes, cbytes, blocksize may be NULL if not needed
Returns negative on failure

functions.name: blosc1_cbuffer_validate
functions.signature: int blosc1_cbuffer_validate(const void* cbuffer, size_t cbytes, size_t* nbytes);
functions.description: Validate that cbuffer of length cbytes may contain valid Blosc data and is safe to attempt decompression/getitem. On success sets *nbytes and returns 0.
requirements: cbuffer must point to cbytes bytes
nbytes must be a valid pointer to receive the uncompressed size on success
Returns negative on failure; success does not guarantee decompression will not error

functions.name: blosc1_cbuffer_metainfo
functions.signature: void blosc1_cbuffer_metainfo(const void* cbuffer, size_t* typesize, int* flags);
functions.description: Retrieve typesize and internal flags (shuffle, memcpy, bitshuffle, delta) from a compressed buffer header.
requirements: cbuffer must point to at least BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH bytes
typesize and flags must be valid pointers

functions.name: blosc2_cbuffer_versions
functions.signature: void blosc2_cbuffer_versions(const void* cbuffer, int* version, int* versionlz);
functions.description: Get Blosc format version and internal codec version from a compressed buffer.
requirements: cbuffer must point to at least BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH bytes
version and versionlz must be valid pointers

functions.name: blosc2_cbuffer_complib
functions.signature: const char* blosc2_cbuffer_complib(const void* cbuffer);
functions.description: Return the compressor library/format name used in the given compressed buffer.
requirements: cbuffer must point to at least BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH bytes
Returned string is library-managed; do not free

functions.name: blosc2_register_io_cb
functions.signature: int blosc2_register_io_cb(const blosc2_io_cb *io);
functions.description: Register a user-defined I/O backend (callbacks) for frames/schunks.
requirements: io must point to a fully-populated blosc2_io_cb structure with valid function pointers
Return 0 on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_get_io_cb
functions.signature: blosc2_io_cb *blosc2_get_io_cb(uint8_t id);
functions.description: Retrieve a previously registered I/O callback set by id.
requirements: id must correspond to a registered IO backend; returns NULL if not found
Returned pointer is owned by the library; do not free

functions.name: blosc2_register_tuner
functions.signature: int blosc2_register_tuner(blosc2_tuner *tuner);
functions.description: Register a user-defined tuning backend to adjust compression parameters dynamically.
requirements: tuner must point to a struct with valid function pointers and metadata
Returns 0 on success; negative on failure

functions.name: blosc2_create_cctx
functions.signature: blosc2_context* blosc2_create_cctx(blosc2_cparams cparams);
functions.description: Create a compression context configured by cparams for use with blosc2_compress_ctx.
requirements: cparams fields may be 0 to use defaults as documented
Returns NULL on failure
Environment variables may override some parameters

functions.name: blosc2_create_dctx
functions.signature: blosc2_context* blosc2_create_dctx(blosc2_dparams dparams);
functions.description: Create a decompression context configured by dparams for use with blosc2_decompress_ctx/getitem_ctx.
requirements: dparams fields may be 0 to use defaults
Returns NULL on failure
Environment variables may override some parameters

functions.name: blosc2_free_ctx
functions.signature: void blosc2_free_ctx(blosc2_context* context);
functions.description: Free resources associated with a compression or decompression context.
requirements: context must be a pointer returned by blosc2_create_cctx or blosc2_create_dctx (or NULL for no-op)
After calling, the context must not be used

functions.name: blosc2_ctx_get_cparams
functions.signature: int blosc2_ctx_get_cparams(blosc2_context *ctx, blosc2_cparams *cparams);
functions.description: Copy the compression parameters associated with a context into cparams.
requirements: ctx must be a valid context
cparams must be a valid pointer to receive parameters
Returns 0 on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_ctx_get_dparams
functions.signature: int blosc2_ctx_get_dparams(blosc2_context *ctx, blosc2_dparams *dparams);
functions.description: Copy the decompression parameters associated with a context into dparams.
requirements: ctx must be a valid context
dparams must be a valid pointer to receive parameters
Returns 0 on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_set_maskout
functions.signature: int blosc2_set_maskout(blosc2_context *ctx, bool *maskout, int nblocks);
functions.description: Set a boolean block mask on a decompression context to skip decompressing specific blocks on the next blosc2_decompress_ctx call.
requirements: ctx must be a decompression context
maskout must point to an array of length nblocks
Mask applies to exactly one subsequent blosc2_decompress_ctx call and is then reset
Returns 0 on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_compress
functions.signature: int blosc2_compress(int clevel, int doshuffle, int32_t typesize, const void* src, int32_t srcsize, void* dest, int32_t destsize);
functions.description: Blosc2 main compression API: compress srcsize bytes from src into dest. Returns compressed size, 0 if dest too small, or negative on error/invalid params.
requirements: src and dest must not overlap
0 <= clevel <= 9
doshuffle must be one of BLOSC_NOFILTER, BLOSC_SHUFFLE, BLOSC_BITSHUFFLE
For shuffle filters to be effective, 1 < typesize < 256; otherwise shuffle is disabled
destsize should be at least srcsize + BLOSC2_MAX_OVERHEAD to guarantee success
Environment variables may override parameters as documented

functions.name: blosc2_decompress
functions.signature: int blosc2_decompress(const void* src, int32_t srcsize, void* dest, int32_t destsize);
functions.description: Blosc2 main decompression API: decompress src buffer of length srcsize into dest of size destsize. Returns decompressed bytes, or negative on error.
requirements: src and dest must not overlap
dest must be large enough; function will not write beyond destsize
Optionally use blosc1_cbuffer_sizes to learn expected output size beforehand

functions.name: blosc2_compress_ctx
functions.signature: int blosc2_compress_ctx(blosc2_context* context, const void* src, int32_t srcsize, void* dest, int32_t destsize);
functions.description: Context-based compression that is safe to call concurrently without a global lock. Uses parameters from context.
requirements: context must be a compression context
src and dest must not overlap
destsize should be >= srcsize + BLOSC2_MAX_OVERHEAD to guarantee success
Returns negative on error (including using a decompression context)

functions.name: blosc2_decompress_ctx
functions.signature: int blosc2_decompress_ctx(blosc2_context* context, const void* src, int32_t srcsize, void* dest, int32_t destsize);
functions.description: Context-based decompression that is safe for concurrent use. Honors an optional block mask set via blosc2_set_maskout for a single call.
requirements: context must be a decompression context
src and dest must not overlap
dest must have at least destsize bytes
May use blosc1_cbuffer_sizes to estimate nbytes beforehand
Mask set by blosc2_set_maskout is reset after this call

functions.name: blosc2_chunk_zeros
functions.signature: int blosc2_chunk_zeros(blosc2_cparams cparams, int32_t nbytes, void* dest, int32_t destsize);
functions.description: Create a special-value chunk representing nbytes of zeros using provided compression parameters. Writes into dest.
requirements: destsize must be at least BLOSC_EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH
Returns BLOSC_EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_chunk_nans
functions.signature: int blosc2_chunk_nans(blosc2_cparams cparams, int32_t nbytes, void* dest, int32_t destsize);
functions.description: Create a special-value chunk representing nbytes of NaNs. Supported for typesize 4 (float) and 8 (double), as given in cparams.typesize.
requirements: cparams.typesize must be 4 or 8
destsize must be at least BLOSC_EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH
Returns BLOSC_EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_chunk_repeatval
functions.signature: int blosc2_chunk_repeatval(blosc2_cparams cparams, int32_t nbytes, void* dest, int32_t destsize, const void* repeatval);
functions.description: Create a special-value chunk representing nbytes of the repeated value pointed by repeatval (size equals cparams.typesize).
requirements: repeatval must point to at least cparams.typesize bytes in little-endian form
destsize must be at least BLOSC_EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH + cparams.typesize (implied by return)
Returns BLOSC_EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH + typesize on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_chunk_uninit
functions.signature: int blosc2_chunk_uninit(blosc2_cparams cparams, int32_t nbytes, void* dest, int32_t destsize);
functions.description: Create a special-value chunk representing nbytes of uninitialized values.
requirements: destsize must be at least BLOSC_EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH
Returns BLOSC_EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_getitem_ctx
functions.signature: int blosc2_getitem_ctx(blosc2_context* context, const void* src, int32_t srcsize, int start, int nitems, void* dest, int32_t destsize);
functions.description: Context interface to extract nitems from compressed buffer src starting at logical item start into dest.
requirements: context must be a valid context (typically decompression)
src must point to srcsize bytes of compressed data
start >= 0; nitems >= 0
dest must have capacity destsize >= nitems * typesize

functions.name: blosc2_get_blosc2_cparams_defaults
functions.signature: blosc2_cparams blosc2_get_blosc2_cparams_defaults(void);
functions.description: Return a blosc2_cparams structure populated with library defaults for easy initialization.

functions.name: blosc2_get_blosc2_dparams_defaults
functions.signature: blosc2_dparams blosc2_get_blosc2_dparams_defaults(void);
functions.description: Return a blosc2_dparams structure populated with library defaults for easy initialization.

functions.name: blosc2_get_blosc2_storage_defaults
functions.signature: blosc2_storage blosc2_get_blosc2_storage_defaults(void);
functions.description: Return a blosc2_storage structure populated with library defaults.

functions.name: blosc2_get_blosc2_io_defaults
functions.signature: blosc2_io blosc2_get_blosc2_io_defaults(void);
functions.description: Return a blosc2_io structure populated with defaults (e.g., filesystem backend).

functions.name: blosc2_get_blosc2_stdio_mmap_defaults
functions.signature: blosc2_stdio_mmap blosc2_get_blosc2_stdio_mmap_defaults(void);
functions.description: Return a blosc2_stdio_mmap structure with default parameters for stdio mmap I/O.

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_new
functions.signature: blosc2_schunk* blosc2_schunk_new(blosc2_storage *storage);
functions.description: Create a new super-chunk (schunk) container, optionally on-disk if storage->urlpath is set (existing files are overwritten).
requirements: storage must point to a blosc2_storage; fields may be NULL to use defaults
If storage->urlpath is not NULL and exists, it will be overwritten

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_copy
functions.signature: blosc2_schunk* blosc2_schunk_copy(blosc2_schunk *schunk, blosc2_storage *storage);
functions.description: Create a copy of an existing super-chunk, optionally to a different storage backend.
requirements: schunk must be a valid super-chunk
storage defines where the copy is created; may overwrite existing destination if persistent

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_from_buffer
functions.signature: blosc2_schunk* blosc2_schunk_from_buffer(uint8_t *cframe, int64_t len, bool copy);
functions.description: Create a super-chunk from an in-memory contiguous frame buffer. If copy==false, the buffer becomes owned by the schunk.
requirements: cframe must point to len bytes of a valid frame
If copy is false, do not free cframe; ownership transfers to the schunk and it will be freed at schunk free (unless avoided via API)

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_avoid_cframe_free
functions.signature: void blosc2_schunk_avoid_cframe_free(blosc2_schunk *schunk, bool avoid_cframe_free);
functions.description: Set the internal flag to avoid freeing the underlying cframe when freeing the schunk.
requirements: If set to true, caller is responsible for freeing the cframe later
schunk must reference a frame-backed schunk

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_open
functions.signature: blosc2_schunk* blosc2_schunk_open(const char* urlpath);
functions.description: Open an existing on-disk frame as a super-chunk without copying data into memory.
requirements: urlpath must refer to an existing frame file; returns NULL if not found or not frame format
No in-memory copy is made; underlying file is used

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_open_offset
functions.signature: blosc2_schunk* blosc2_schunk_open_offset(const char* urlpath, int64_t offset);
functions.description: Open an existing on-disk frame at a given file offset as a super-chunk without making a copy.
requirements: urlpath must refer to an existing file
offset must point to a valid frame start
Returns NULL if not found or not a frame

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_open_udio
functions.signature: blosc2_schunk* blosc2_schunk_open_udio(const char* urlpath, const blosc2_io *udio);
functions.description: Open an existing super-chunk via a user-defined I/O interface without copying.
requirements: udio must reference a valid registered/defined I/O backend
urlpath must identify the resource in the backend

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_open_offset_udio
functions.signature: blosc2_schunk* blosc2_schunk_open_offset_udio(const char* urlpath, int64_t offset, const blosc2_io *udio);
functions.description: Open an existing super-chunk at a given offset via a user-defined I/O interface.
requirements: offset must indicate a valid frame start within the resource
udio must reference a valid I/O backend

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_to_buffer
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_schunk_to_buffer(blosc2_schunk* schunk, uint8_t** cframe, bool* needs_free);
functions.description: Serialize a super-chunk to a contiguous in-memory frame. Returns frame size. Indicates via needs_free whether the caller must free *cframe.
requirements: schunk must be valid
cframe must be a valid pointer to receive the buffer pointer
needs_free must be a valid pointer to receive ownership info
On success, if *needs_free is true, caller must free(*cframe)

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_to_file
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_schunk_to_file(blosc2_schunk* schunk, const char* urlpath);
functions.description: Write a super-chunk to a file frame at urlpath. Returns fileframe size or negative on error.
requirements: schunk must be valid
urlpath must be a valid path; may overwrite existing file

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_append_file
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_schunk_append_file(blosc2_schunk* schunk, const char* urlpath);
functions.description: Append a super-chunk to an existing file frame. Returns the offset where it was appended.
requirements: schunk must be valid
urlpath must refer to a writable file

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_free
functions.signature: int blosc2_schunk_free(blosc2_schunk *schunk);
functions.description: Free resources associated with a super-chunk. On-disk data remains available for later re-opening.
requirements: schunk must be a valid super-chunk pointer (NULL checks handled internally)
Returns 0 on success

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_append_chunk
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_schunk_append_chunk(blosc2_schunk *schunk, uint8_t *chunk, bool copy);
functions.description: Append an existing compressed chunk to a super-chunk. If copy==true, an internal copy is made.
requirements: schunk must be valid
chunk must point to a valid compressed chunk
If copy is false, the buffer must remain valid for the lifetime of the schunk entry
Returns new number of chunks or negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_update_chunk
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_schunk_update_chunk(blosc2_schunk *schunk, int64_t nchunk, uint8_t *chunk, bool copy);
functions.description: Replace the chunk at position nchunk with a new compressed chunk.
requirements: schunk must be valid
0 <= nchunk < schunk->nchunks
chunk must point to a valid compressed chunk
If copy is false, buffer lifetime must outlive the schunk record

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_insert_chunk
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_schunk_insert_chunk(blosc2_schunk *schunk, int64_t nchunk, uint8_t *chunk, bool copy);
functions.description: Insert a compressed chunk at position nchunk, shifting subsequent chunks.
requirements: schunk must be valid
0 <= nchunk <= schunk->nchunks
chunk must be a valid compressed chunk
If copy is false, buffer must stay valid as long as needed

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_delete_chunk
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_schunk_delete_chunk(blosc2_schunk *schunk, int64_t nchunk);
functions.description: Delete the chunk at index nchunk from a super-chunk.
requirements: schunk must be valid
0 <= nchunk < schunk->nchunks

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_append_buffer
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_schunk_append_buffer(blosc2_schunk *schunk, const void *src, int32_t nbytes);
functions.description: Compress and append the raw data buffer src of size nbytes as a new chunk in the super-chunk.
requirements: schunk must be valid
src must point to at least nbytes bytes
Returns new number of chunks or negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk
functions.signature: int blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk(blosc2_schunk *schunk, int64_t nchunk, void *dest, int32_t nbytes);
functions.description: Decompress the chunk at index nchunk into dest with capacity nbytes. Returns decompressed size, 0 if non-initialized, or negative on error.
requirements: schunk must be valid
0 <= nchunk < schunk->nchunks
dest must have at least nbytes bytes
Caller must ensure capacity is sufficient for the uncompressed chunk

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_get_chunk
functions.signature: int blosc2_schunk_get_chunk(blosc2_schunk *schunk, int64_t nchunk, uint8_t **chunk, bool *needs_free);
functions.description: Retrieve a pointer to the compressed chunk data at index nchunk. Indicates via needs_free whether the caller must free the returned buffer.
requirements: schunk must be valid
0 <= nchunk < schunk->nchunks
chunk must be a valid pointer to receive the chunk pointer
needs_free must be a valid pointer; if *needs_free is true, caller must free(*chunk)
For disk-backed frames, a buffer is typically allocated and must be freed

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_get_lazychunk
functions.signature: int blosc2_schunk_get_lazychunk(blosc2_schunk *schunk, int64_t nchunk, uint8_t **chunk, bool *needs_free);
functions.description: Retrieve a (possibly lazy) compressed chunk at index nchunk. Lazy chunks can be consumed by blosc2_decompress_ctx and blosc2_getitem_ctx.
requirements: schunk must be valid
0 <= nchunk < schunk->nchunks
chunk and needs_free must be valid pointers
For disk-based frames, a lazy chunk is always returned
Lazy chunks are larger due to a trailer; only certain APIs may consume them

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_get_slice_buffer
functions.signature: int blosc2_schunk_get_slice_buffer(blosc2_schunk *schunk, int64_t start, int64_t stop, void *buffer);
functions.description: Decompress a slice [start, stop) from a super-chunk into buffer.
requirements: schunk must be valid
0 <= start <= stop <= logical length of the schunk
buffer must have enough space for the uncompressed slice
Returns error code (0 on success implied)

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_set_slice_buffer
functions.signature: int blosc2_schunk_set_slice_buffer(blosc2_schunk *schunk, int64_t start, int64_t stop, void *buffer);
functions.description: Update a slice [start, stop) of a super-chunk from the data in buffer.
requirements: schunk must be valid
0 <= start <= stop
buffer must contain at least the slice size in bytes
Returns error code

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_get_cparams
functions.signature: int blosc2_schunk_get_cparams(blosc2_schunk *schunk, blosc2_cparams **cparams);
functions.description: Allocate and return a copy of the compression parameters associated with schunk via *cparams. Caller must free.
requirements: schunk must be valid
cparams must be a valid pointer to receive a newly allocated struct
Caller must free(*cparams) after use
Returns 0 on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_get_dparams
functions.signature: int blosc2_schunk_get_dparams(blosc2_schunk *schunk, blosc2_dparams **dparams);
functions.description: Allocate and return a copy of the decompression parameters associated with schunk via *dparams. Caller must free.
requirements: schunk must be valid
dparams must be a valid pointer to receive a newly allocated struct
Caller must free(*dparams) after use
Returns 0 on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_reorder_offsets
functions.signature: int blosc2_schunk_reorder_offsets(blosc2_schunk *schunk, int64_t *offsets_order);
functions.description: Reorder the chunk offsets within a super-chunk according to offsets_order.
requirements: schunk must be valid
offsets_order must be a valid array specifying the new order for all chunk offsets
Returns 0 on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_frame_len
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_schunk_frame_len(blosc2_schunk* schunk);
functions.description: Return the length in bytes of the internal frame, or an estimate if none exists.
requirements: schunk must be valid

functions.name: blosc2_schunk_fill_special
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_schunk_fill_special(blosc2_schunk* schunk, int64_t nitems, int special_value, int32_t chunksize);
functions.description: Quickly fill an empty frame-backed schunk with special values (zeros, NaNs, or uninitialized) using the given chunksize. Returns number of chunks added.
requirements: schunk must be empty initially
special_value must be one of BLOSC2_SPECIAL_ZERO, BLOSC2_SPECIAL_NAN, BLOSC2_SPECIAL_UNINIT
chunksize must be a positive integer
Returns negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_vlmeta_exists
functions.signature: int blosc2_vlmeta_exists(blosc2_schunk *schunk, const char *name);
functions.description: Check if a variable-length metalayer with the given name exists. Returns index or negative if not found.
requirements: name length must be within the allowed maximum for metalayer names (implied by overall metalayer constraints)
schunk must be valid

functions.name: blosc2_vlmeta_add
functions.signature: int blosc2_vlmeta_add(blosc2_schunk *schunk, const char *name, uint8_t *content, int32_t content_len, blosc2_cparams *cparams);
functions.description: Add a new variable-length metalayer with name and content, optionally compressed with cparams (defaults used if NULL). Returns index.
requirements: schunk must be valid
name must fit within BLOSC2_VLMETALAYERS_NAME_MAXLEN
content must point to content_len bytes
cparams may be NULL to use defaults

functions.name: blosc2_vlmeta_update
functions.signature: int blosc2_vlmeta_update(blosc2_schunk *schunk, const char *name, uint8_t *content, int32_t content_len, blosc2_cparams *cparams);
functions.description: Update the content of an existing variable-length metalayer, optionally specifying compression params.
requirements: schunk must be valid
name must reference an existing vlmetalayer
content must point to content_len bytes
cparams may be NULL to use defaults

functions.name: blosc2_vlmeta_get
functions.signature: int blosc2_vlmeta_get(blosc2_schunk *schunk, const char *name, uint8_t **content, int32_t *content_len);
functions.description: Retrieve and decompress a variable-length metalayer's content. Returns index and allocates *content; caller frees.
requirements: schunk must be valid
name must exist
content and content_len must be valid pointers
On success, *content is malloc'ed; caller must free(*content)

functions.name: blosc2_vlmeta_delete
functions.signature: int blosc2_vlmeta_delete(blosc2_schunk *schunk, const char *name);
functions.description: Delete a variable-length metalayer by name. Returns number of remaining vlmetalayers on success.
requirements: schunk must be valid
name must refer to an existing vlmetalayer

functions.name: blosc2_vlmeta_get_names
functions.signature: int blosc2_vlmeta_get_names(blosc2_schunk *schunk, char **names);
functions.description: Get pointers to the names of all variable-length metalayers in schunk. Returns count.
requirements: schunk must be valid
names must point to a buffer of at least schunk->nvlmetalayers pointers (char*), provided by caller
Caller must not free or modify the name strings themselves

functions.name: blosc_set_timestamp
functions.signature: void blosc_set_timestamp(blosc_timestamp_t* timestamp);
functions.description: Fill timestamp with the current time, platform-specific.
requirements: timestamp must be a valid pointer to a blosc_timestamp_t

functions.name: blosc_elapsed_nsecs
functions.signature: double blosc_elapsed_nsecs(blosc_timestamp_t start_time, blosc_timestamp_t end_time);
functions.description: Return the elapsed time in nanoseconds between two timestamps.
requirements: start_time and end_time must be values previously obtained via blosc_set_timestamp

functions.name: blosc_elapsed_secs
functions.signature: double blosc_elapsed_secs(blosc_timestamp_t start_time, blosc_timestamp_t end_time);
functions.description: Return the elapsed time in seconds between two timestamps.
requirements: start_time and end_time must be values previously obtained via blosc_set_timestamp

functions.name: blosc1_get_blocksize
functions.signature: int blosc1_get_blocksize(void);
functions.description: Return the current internal blocksize for compression (0 means automatic).

functions.name: blosc1_set_blocksize
functions.signature: void blosc1_set_blocksize(size_t blocksize);
functions.description: Force a specific internal blocksize for compression; 0 reverts to automatic selection.
requirements: Blocksize has important restrictions on allowed values; use with care (see library documentation)

functions.name: blosc1_set_splitmode
functions.signature: void blosc1_set_splitmode(int splitmode);
functions.description: Set the block split mode used during compression (FORWARD_COMPAT, AUTO, NEVER, ALWAYS).
requirements: splitmode must be one of BLOSC_FORWARD_COMPAT_SPLIT, BLOSC_AUTO_SPLIT, BLOSC_NEVER_SPLIT, BLOSC_ALWAYS_SPLIT
Defaults to BLOSC_FORWARD_COMPAT_SPLIT if not called

functions.name: blosc2_frame_get_offsets
functions.signature: int64_t* blosc2_frame_get_offsets(blosc2_schunk *schunk);
functions.description: Return a newly allocated array of decompressed chunk offsets for the frame backing schunk. Array length equals schunk->nchunks.
requirements: schunk must be valid and frame-backed
Caller is responsible for freeing the returned buffer
Returns NULL on error

functions.name: blosc2_register_codec
functions.signature: int blosc2_register_codec(blosc2_codec *codec);
functions.description: Register a user-defined codec (encoder/decoder) with the library.
requirements: codec must point to a struct with valid fields and function pointers
Returns 0 on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_register_filter
functions.signature: int blosc2_register_filter(blosc2_filter *filter);
functions.description: Register a user-defined filter plugin (forward/backward callbacks).
requirements: filter must point to a struct with valid fields and callbacks
Returns 0 on success; negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_remove_dir
functions.signature: int blosc2_remove_dir(const char *path);
functions.description: Remove a directory and its files recursively.
requirements: path must point to an existing directory path
Returns 0 on success; negative on failure

functions.name: blosc2_remove_urlpath
functions.signature: int blosc2_remove_urlpath(const char *path);
functions.description: Remove a file or directory specified by path.
requirements: path must refer to an existing file or directory
Returns 0 on success; negative on failure

functions.name: blosc2_rename_urlpath
functions.signature: int blosc2_rename_urlpath(char* old_urlpath, char* new_path);
functions.description: Rename a file or directory from old_urlpath to new_path.
requirements: old_urlpath and new_path must be valid paths
Returns 0 on success; negative on failure

functions.name: blosc2_unidim_to_multidim
functions.signature: void blosc2_unidim_to_multidim(uint8_t ndim, int64_t *shape, int64_t i, int64_t *index);
functions.description: Convert a flat (unidimensional) index i into a multidimensional index given shape and ndim.
requirements: ndim must be <= BLOSC2_MAX_DIM (inferred by general constraints)
shape must be an array of length ndim with positive extents
index must point to an array of length ndim

functions.name: blosc2_multidim_to_unidim
functions.signature: void blosc2_multidim_to_unidim(const int64_t *index, int8_t ndim, const int64_t *strides, int64_t *i);
functions.description: Convert a multidimensional index into a flat index using provided strides.
requirements: ndim must be <= BLOSC2_MAX_DIM (inferred)
index and strides must point to arrays of length ndim
i must be a valid pointer to receive the flat index

functions.name: blosc2_get_slice_nchunks
functions.signature: int blosc2_get_slice_nchunks(blosc2_schunk* schunk, int64_t *start, int64_t *stop, int64_t **chunks_idx);
functions.description: Compute the indices of chunks needed to cover a slice [start, stop) of a schunk (or b2nd array). Returns number of chunks and writes their indices to *chunks_idx.
requirements: schunk must be valid
start and stop must be valid pointers to index vectors appropriate for the container
chunks_idx must be a valid pointer; returned buffer must be freed by the user
Returns negative on error

functions.name: blosc2_shuffle
functions.signature: int32_t blosc2_shuffle(const int32_t typesize, const int32_t blocksize, const void* src, void* dest);
functions.description: Apply byte-wise shuffle to a block of data. Returns blocksize on success or negative on invalid parameters.
requirements: src and dest must not overlap
1 < typesize < 256
blocksize >= 0 and denotes number of bytes to process
src must point to at least blocksize bytes; dest must have at least blocksize bytes

functions.name: blosc2_unshuffle
functions.signature: int32_t blosc2_unshuffle(const int32_t typesize, const int32_t blocksize, const void* src, void* dest);
functions.description: Inverse of blosc2_shuffle: reconstruct original data from a shuffled block.
requirements: src and dest must not overlap
1 < typesize < 256
blocksize >= 0; buffers must be at least blocksize bytes

functions.name: blosc2_bitshuffle
functions.signature: int32_t blosc2_bitshuffle(const int32_t typesize, const int32_t blocksize, const void* src, void* dest);
functions.description: Apply bit-wise shuffle to a block of data. Processes the maximum number of elements divisible by 8; remaining tail is copied unchanged.
requirements: src and dest must not overlap
1 < typesize < 256
blocksize >= 0; buffers must be at least blocksize bytes

functions.name: blosc2_bitunshuffle
functions.signature: int32_t blosc2_bitunshuffle(const int32_t typesize, const int32_t blocksize, const void* src, void* dest);
functions.description: Inverse of blosc2_bitshuffle: reconstruct original data from a bitshuffled block. Tail handling mirrors the forward transform.
requirements: src and dest must not overlap
1 < typesize < 256
blocksize >= 0; buffers must be at least blocksize bytes

functions.name: b2nd_create_ctx
functions.description: Create and return a new Blosc2 NDim context (parameters holder) for building a b2nd array. Use with array-creation APIs and free with b2nd_free_ctx.
requirements: Caller must free the returned context with b2nd_free_ctx when no longer needed (per note).
ndim is the number of dimensions for the target array (must be representable by int8_t).
shape, chunkshape, blockshape point to arrays describing geometry; their expected lengths are ndim (implied by typical API patterns).
dtype is a string representation of the data type; dtype_format selects its format, where 0 indicates NumPy compatibility (per comment).
metalayers points to a list of desired metalayers and nmetalayers is its length; count must not exceed B2ND_MAX_METALAYERS (implied by constant).

functions.name: b2nd_free_ctx
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_free_ctx(b2nd_context_t *ctx);
functions.description: Free resources associated with a b2nd_context_t created by b2nd_create_ctx. Safe in that it does not free any schunk pointer in internal cparams.
requirements: ctx should be a context previously obtained from b2nd_create_ctx.
This will not free any schunk pointer in internal cparams (per note).
Check returned error code to ensure successful release.

functions.name: b2nd_uninit
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_uninit(b2nd_context_t *ctx, b2nd_array_t **array);
functions.description: Create a new uninitialized b2nd array using the provided context. The array data contents are unspecified.
requirements: ctx must be a valid b2nd context created earlier.
array must be a non-null out-parameter pointer to receive the created array.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_empty
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_empty(b2nd_context_t *ctx, b2nd_array_t **array);
functions.description: Create a new empty b2nd array (no default fill for data) using the provided context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid b2nd context.
array must be a non-null out-parameter pointer to receive the array.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_zeros
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_zeros(b2nd_context_t *ctx, b2nd_array_t **array);
functions.description: Create a new b2nd array whose uninitialized portions are set to zero by default.
requirements: ctx must be a valid b2nd context.
array must be a non-null out-parameter pointer to receive the array.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_nans
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_nans(b2nd_context_t *ctx, b2nd_array_t **array);
functions.description: Create a new b2nd array whose uninitialized portions are set to NaN by default. Only valid for item sizes of 4 or 8 bytes.
requirements: Only use with type sizes of 4 or 8 bytes; other sizes generate an error (per comment).
ctx must be a valid b2nd context.
array must be a non-null out-parameter.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_full
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_full(b2nd_context_t *ctx, b2nd_array_t **array, const void *fill_value);
functions.description: Create a new b2nd array whose uninitialized portions are filled with the provided fill_value.
requirements: ctx must be a valid b2nd context.
array must be a non-null out-parameter.
fill_value must point to a value compatible with the array's dtype size and format (inferred from signature).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_free
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_free(b2nd_array_t *array);
functions.description: Free an allocated b2nd array and its associated resources.
requirements: array must be a b2nd array previously created by a b2nd_* creation/open function.
Do not use the array pointer after successful free.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_from_schunk
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_from_schunk(blosc2_schunk *schunk, b2nd_array_t **array);
functions.description: Create a b2nd array view/handle from an existing Blosc2 super-chunk. Only usable when the array is backed by a super-chunk.
requirements: schunk must be a valid blosc2_schunk with appropriate b2nd metalayer metadata.
array must be a non-null out-parameter.
Function can only be used if the array is backed by a blosc super-chunk (per comment).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_to_cframe
functions.signature:
BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_to_cframe(const b2nd_array_t *array, uint8_t **cframe,
                                int64_t *cframe_len, bool *needs_free);
functions.description: Serialize a b2nd array into a contiguous in-memory frame (cframe) representing a serialized super-chunk.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
cframe must be a non-null out-parameter to receive the buffer pointer.
cframe_len must be a non-null out-parameter to receive the buffer length.
needs_free must be a non-null out-parameter indicating whether the returned buffer needs to be freed by the caller.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_from_cframe
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_from_cframe(uint8_t *cframe, int64_t cframe_len, bool copy, b2nd_array_t **array);
functions.description: Create a b2nd array from a serialized in-memory super-chunk (cframe). If copy is true, data is copied into an internal sparse frame.
requirements: cframe must point to the serialized frame buffer.
cframe_len is the size in bytes of cframe.
copy indicates whether an internal copy should be made (per comment).
array must be a non-null out-parameter.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_open
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_open(const char *urlpath, b2nd_array_t **array);
functions.description: Open a b2nd array from a file path on disk and return a b2nd array handle.
requirements: urlpath must point to a valid path containing a b2nd array frame.
array must be a non-null out-parameter.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_open_offset
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_open_offset(const char *urlpath, b2nd_array_t **array, int64_t offset);
functions.description: Open a b2nd array from a file at a specific byte offset where the b2nd array frame starts.
requirements: urlpath must point to a valid path containing a b2nd array frame.
offset specifies the byte offset in the file where the frame begins.
array must be a non-null out-parameter.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_save
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_save(const b2nd_array_t *array, char *urlpath);
functions.description: Save a b2nd array to a given urlpath on disk, overwriting or creating the destination.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array to serialize.
urlpath must point to a writable path buffer/string.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_save_append
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int64_t b2nd_save_append(const b2nd_array_t *array, const char *urlpath);
functions.description: Append a b2nd array frame to an existing file and return the byte offset where it was appended. Negative return indicates failure.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
urlpath must point to an existing or creatable file path suitable for appending.
Caller must check the return value: non-negative offset on success, negative on error (per comment).

functions.name: b2nd_from_cbuffer
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_from_cbuffer(b2nd_context_t *ctx, b2nd_array_t **array, const void *buffer, int64_t buffersize);
functions.description: Create a b2nd array and populate it from a contiguous C buffer of raw data of the appropriate size.
requirements: ctx must be a valid b2nd context describing the target array.
array must be a non-null out-parameter.
buffer must point to the source data; buffersize is its size in bytes.
buffersize must match the total size implied by the context shape and dtype (inferred).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_to_cbuffer
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_to_cbuffer(const b2nd_array_t *array, void *buffer, int64_t buffersize);
functions.description: Extract the array's data into a contiguous C buffer.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
buffer must point to writable memory; buffersize is its size in bytes.
buffersize must be large enough to hold the full array contents (inferred).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_get_slice
functions.signature:
BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_get_slice(b2nd_context_t *ctx, b2nd_array_t **array, const b2nd_array_t *src,
                                const int64_t *start, const int64_t *stop);
functions.description: Create a new b2nd array containing a slice from src delimited by start (inclusive) and stop (exclusive) coordinates. The ctx's ndim and shape are overwritten by src and by stop-start respectively.
requirements: ctx must be a valid context; its ndim and shape will be overwritten (per note).
array must be a non-null out-parameter.
src must be a valid source array.
start and stop must point to coordinate arrays; their dimensionality must match src->ndim (inferred).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_squeeze_index
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_squeeze_index(b2nd_array_t *array, b2nd_array_t **view, const bool *index);
functions.description: Create a view of array with selected single-dimensional entries removed according to the index mask.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
view must be a non-null out-parameter for the new view.
index must be a boolean mask indicating which single-dimensional axes to remove (inferred).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_squeeze
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_squeeze(b2nd_array_t *array, b2nd_array_t **view);
functions.description: Create a view of array with all single-dimensional entries removed.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
view must be a non-null out-parameter.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_expand_dims
functions.signature:
BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_expand_dims(const b2nd_array_t *array, b2nd_array_t **view, const bool *axis,
    const uint8_t final_dims);
functions.description: Return a view with new axes inserted at positions indicated by axis, expanding to final_dims dimensions (must match count of true in axis).
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
view must be a non-null out-parameter.
axis is a boolean array specifying where to add new dimensions; final_dims should equal the number of true entries (per comment).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_get_slice_cbuffer
functions.signature:
BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_get_slice_cbuffer(const b2nd_array_t *array, const int64_t *start, const int64_t *stop,
                                        void *buffer, const int64_t *buffershape, int64_t buffersize);
functions.description: Extract a slice from array into a user-provided C buffer with the given buffershape and size.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
start and stop must be coordinate arrays defining the slice.
buffer must point to writable memory of size buffersize.
buffershape must describe the expected shape of the slice in the buffer.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_set_slice_cbuffer
functions.signature:
BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_set_slice_cbuffer(const void *buffer, const int64_t *buffershape, int64_t buffersize,
                                        const int64_t *start, const int64_t *stop, b2nd_array_t *array);
functions.description: Set a slice within array from a user-provided C buffer, whose shape and size must match the slice defined by start/stop.
requirements: buffer must point to the source data of size buffersize.
buffershape must match the slice shape implied by start/stop.
start and stop define the coordinates where the slice is written.
array must be a valid destination b2nd array.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_copy
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_copy(b2nd_context_t *ctx, const b2nd_array_t *src, b2nd_array_t **array);
functions.description: Make a deep copy of src into a new b2nd array using ctx. ctx->ndim and shape will be overwritten by src ctx.
requirements: ctx must be valid; its ndim and shape will be overwritten by src (per note).
src must be a valid b2nd array.
array must be a non-null out-parameter.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_concatenate
functions.signature:
BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_concatenate(b2nd_context_t *ctx, const b2nd_array_t *src1, const b2nd_array_t *src2,
                                  int8_t axis, bool copy, b2nd_array_t **array);
functions.description: Concatenate src1 and src2 along the specified axis, returning a new array or enlarging src1 depending on copy. Result keeps src1 metalayers, updating b2nd metalayer shape.
requirements: The two arrays must have the same shape in all dimensions except the concatenation axis (per note).
The typesize of the two arrays must be the same (per note).
If copy is false, src1 will be expanded as needed to hold the result (per comment).
ctx must be valid; its ndim and shape will be overwritten by src1 (per note).
array must be a non-null out-parameter.
axis selects the concatenation dimension; must be a valid axis index (inferred).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_print_meta
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_print_meta(const b2nd_array_t *array);
functions.description: Print the b2nd metalayer parameters of the provided array to standard output (or logging).
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.

functions.name: b2nd_resize
functions.signature: BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_resize(b2nd_array_t *array, const int64_t *new_shape, const int64_t *start);
functions.description: Resize the array shape to new_shape, extending or shrinking starting at coordinates given by start.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
new_shape must point to an array of length array->ndim (inferred).
start specifies the position where extension/shrinking occurs.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_insert
functions.signature:
BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_insert(b2nd_array_t *array, const void *buffer, int64_t buffersize,
                             int8_t axis, int64_t insert_start);
functions.description: Insert data from buffer into array, extending the specified axis starting at insert_start.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
buffer must point to the data to insert and be buffersize bytes.
axis is the axis to extend; must be valid for the array (inferred).
insert_start is the position along axis where to start inserting.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_append
functions.signature:
BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_append(b2nd_array_t *array, const void *buffer, int64_t buffersize,
                             int8_t axis);
functions.description: Append data from buffer at the end of the array along the specified axis.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
buffer must point to the data to append and be buffersize bytes.
axis is the axis to extend; must be valid for the array (inferred).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_delete
functions.signature:
BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_delete(b2nd_array_t *array, int8_t axis,
                             int64_t delete_start, int64_t delete_len);
functions.description: Delete items along the given axis, starting at delete_start and removing delete_len items, shrinking the array. New shape on axis becomes old - delete_len.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
axis is the axis to shrink; must be valid for the array (inferred).
delete_start is the start position along axis.
delete_len is the number of items to remove. New shape will be old_shape[axis] - delete_len (per comment).
See also b2nd_resize (per note).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_get_orthogonal_selection
functions.description: Fetch an orthogonal selection of elements (independent lists of indices per dimension) into a buffer with the specified shape and size.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
selection is an array of index arrays, one per dimension; selection_size gives their lengths (inferred).
buffer must point to writable memory of size buffersize.
buffershape must match the result selection shape (inferred).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_set_orthogonal_selection
functions.description: Write data from buffer into an orthogonal selection of positions in array, according to per-dimension index lists.
requirements: array must be a valid b2nd array.
selection is an array of index arrays, one per dimension; selection_size gives their lengths (inferred).
buffer must point to the source data of size buffersize.
buffershape must match the selection's shape (inferred).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_serialize_meta
functions.description: Create the serialized msgpack metainfo for the b2nd metalayer, based on array geometry and dtype, returning it via smeta.
requirements: ndim is the number of dimensions; must be consistent with the lengths of shape, chunkshape, blockshape (inferred).
dtype is a string representation of the array data type.
dtype_format specifies the dtype representation; 0 means NumPy (per comment).
smeta must be a non-null out-parameter to receive the allocated msgpack buffer.
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_deserialize_meta
functions.signature:
BLOSC_EXPORT int b2nd_deserialize_meta(const uint8_t *smeta, int32_t smeta_len, int8_t *ndim, int64_t *shape,
                                       int32_t *chunkshape, int32_t *blockshape, char **dtype, int8_t *dtype_format);
functions.description: Parse a msgpack-encoded b2nd metalayer and return the decoded geometry and dtype information. Available inline even when not linking with libblosc2.
requirements: smeta must point to the msgpack buffer; smeta_len is its length.
ndim, shape, chunkshape, blockshape, dtype, dtype_format are output parameters receiving decoded values.
0 means NumPy for dtype_format (per comment).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_copy_buffer
functions.description: Deprecated helper to copy a slice from a source C buffer into a destination C buffer for arrays with the same ndim and item size. Does not perform boundary checks; caller must ensure slice fits. New code should use b2nd_copy_buffer2.
requirements: ndim is the number of dimensions in both arrays (per comment).
itemsize is the size of each data item in bytes (uint8_t) (per comment).
src/src_pad_shape/src_start/src_stop describe the source array and slice (per comment).
dst/dst_pad_shape/dst_start describe the destination array and placement (per comment).
Caller must ensure slice boundaries fit within source and destination arrays; function does not perform these checks (per note).
Function is deprecated; prefer b2nd_copy_buffer2 (per note).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: b2nd_copy_buffer2
functions.description: Copy a slice from a source C buffer into a destination C buffer, using 32-bit itemsize to support items >255 bytes. No boundary checks; caller must ensure slice fits.
requirements: ndim is the number of dimensions in both arrays (per comment).
itemsize is the size of each data item in bytes (int32_t) (per comment).
src/src_pad_shape/src_start/src_stop describe the source array and slice (per comment).
dst/dst_pad_shape/dst_start describe the destination array and placement (per comment).
Caller must ensure slice boundaries fit within source and destination arrays; function does not perform these checks (per note).
Check the returned error code.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_open
functions.signature: void *blosc2_stdio_open(const char *urlpath, const char *mode, void* params);
functions.description: Opens a stdio-backed stream for file I/O. Similar in spirit to fopen: urlpath is the file path, mode is a C stdio mode string, and params is an optional implementation-specific parameter block (likely unused for plain stdio). Returns an opaque stream handle to be used with the other blosc2_stdio_* functions.
requirements: urlpath must be a valid, non-NULL path string to a file.
mode must be a valid, non-NULL fopen-style mode (e.g., "r", "rb", "w+", etc.).
params may be NULL or an implementation-defined pointer; if non-NULL, it must match what this backend expects (details unknown).
The returned pointer must be passed to blosc2_stdio_close when finished.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_close
functions.signature: int blosc2_stdio_close(void *stream);
functions.description: Closes a stdio-backed stream previously opened by blosc2_stdio_open and releases associated resources.
requirements: stream must be a non-NULL handle returned by blosc2_stdio_open and not already closed.
Must be called exactly once for each successful blosc2_stdio_open.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_size
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_stdio_size(void *stream);
functions.description: Returns the current size (in bytes) of the underlying file for a stdio-backed stream.
requirements: stream must be a valid handle returned by blosc2_stdio_open.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_write
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_stdio_write(const void *ptr, int64_t size, int64_t nitems, int64_t position, void *stream);
functions.description: Writes nitems items of length size from ptr into the underlying file at absolute byte position. Intended for random-access writes; may extend the file.
requirements: stream must be a valid handle returned by blosc2_stdio_open.
ptr must be non-NULL if size > 0 and nitems > 0.
size must be >= 0; nitems must be >= 0; position must be >= 0.
The buffer at ptr must contain at least size * nitems bytes.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_read
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_stdio_read(void **ptr, int64_t size, int64_t nitems, int64_t position, void *stream);
functions.description: Reads nitems items of length size from the underlying file at absolute byte position. On success, sets *ptr to a buffer containing the requested data and returns the number of items read. Exact ownership and lifetime of the returned buffer are not documented here; treat as implementation-defined.
requirements: stream must be a valid handle returned by blosc2_stdio_open.
ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a void* (output parameter).
size must be >= 0; nitems must be >= 0; position must be >= 0.
Caller should not assume ownership of *ptr without backend-specific documentation; copying the data out is safest given unknown ownership.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_truncate
functions.signature: int blosc2_stdio_truncate(void *stream, int64_t size);
functions.description: Truncates or extends the underlying file to the specified size (in bytes) for a stdio-backed stream.
requirements: stream must be a valid handle returned by blosc2_stdio_open.
size must be >= 0.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_destroy
functions.signature: int blosc2_stdio_destroy(void* params);
functions.description: Destroys/frees the parameter object associated with the stdio backend (if any). Intended as a destroy callback for params passed to open. No effect on active streams.
requirements: params may be NULL or must be a pointer to a params object compatible with this backend (exact structure unknown).
Must not be used to close an open stream; use blosc2_stdio_close for streams.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_mmap_open
functions.signature: void *blosc2_stdio_mmap_open(const char *urlpath, const char *mode, void* params);
functions.description: Opens a memory-mapped I/O stream for a file at urlpath. Mode follows numpy.memmap semantics: r (read-only), r+ (read/write existing), w+ (create new, read/write), c (copy-on-write; changes not persisted). params should point to a blosc2_stdio_mmap configuration struct (see BLOSC2_STDIO_MMAP_DEFAULTS) to control mapping behavior (e.g., initial_mapping_size). Returns an opaque stream handle for use with the blosc2_stdio_mmap_* functions.
requirements: urlpath must be a valid, non-NULL path string.
mode must be one of: "r", "r+", "w+", or "c".

params is expected to be either NULL (backend defaults) or a pointer to a properly initialized blosc2_stdio_mmap struct. If dynamically allocated and needs freeing in destroy, set needs_free=true in that struct.

For mode "r" the file must exist. For "r+" the file should exist and be writable. For "w+" a new file is created (existing may be truncated). Mode "c" uses an existing file as basis but keeps modifications in-memory (not persisted).
On Windows, the size of the mapping cannot change in mode "c"; initial_mapping_size will be the mapping and file size while open.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_mmap_close
functions.signature: int blosc2_stdio_mmap_close(void *stream);
functions.description: Closes a memory-mapped stream opened by blosc2_stdio_mmap_open, unmapping the region and releasing resources.
requirements: stream must be a non-NULL handle returned by blosc2_stdio_mmap_open and not already closed.
Must be called exactly once for each successful blosc2_stdio_mmap_open.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_mmap_size
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_stdio_mmap_size(void *stream);
functions.description: Returns the current file size (in bytes) associated with a memory-mapped stream.
requirements: stream must be a valid handle returned by blosc2_stdio_mmap_open.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_mmap_write
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_stdio_mmap_write(const void *ptr, int64_t size, int64_t nitems, int64_t position, void *stream);
functions.description: Writes nitems items of length size from ptr into the memory-mapped file at absolute byte position. May grow the mapping/file where supported.
requirements: stream must be a valid handle returned by blosc2_stdio_mmap_open.
ptr must be non-NULL if size > 0 and nitems > 0.
size must be >= 0; nitems must be >= 0; position must be >= 0.
The buffer at ptr must contain at least size * nitems bytes.
On Windows, mapping size changes are not supported in mode "c" (copy-on-write).

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_mmap_read
functions.signature: int64_t blosc2_stdio_mmap_read(void **ptr, int64_t size, int64_t nitems, int64_t position, void *stream);
functions.description: Reads nitems items of length size from a memory-mapped stream at absolute byte position. On success, sets *ptr to point directly into the mapped memory (zero-copy when aligned/available) and returns the number of items read.
requirements: stream must be a valid handle returned by blosc2_stdio_mmap_open.
ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to a void* (output parameter).
size must be >= 0; nitems must be >= 0; position must be >= 0.
The returned pointer (*ptr) is valid while the mapping remains open and is not resized/truncated; do not free it.
Caller should treat *ptr as read-only unless the mode and mapping permissions allow writing.

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_mmap_truncate
functions.signature: int blosc2_stdio_mmap_truncate(void *stream, int64_t size);
functions.description: Adjusts the underlying file and mapping to the specified size (in bytes). May extend or shrink the mapping, subject to OS and mode constraints.
requirements: stream must be a valid handle returned by blosc2_stdio_mmap_open.
size must be >= 0.
On Windows, mapping size cannot change in mode "c".

functions.name: blosc2_stdio_mmap_destroy
functions.signature: int blosc2_stdio_mmap_destroy(void* params);
functions.description: Destroys/frees a blosc2_stdio_mmap parameter object (configuration) used with blosc2_stdio_mmap_open. Does not close active mappings; use blosc2_stdio_mmap_close for streams.
requirements: params may be NULL or must point to a blosc2_stdio_mmap struct compatible with this backend.
If the struct was heap-allocated and needs freeing via this callback, its needs_free field should be true.
